name: Data Cleaning
description: Clean messy sheet data through MCP tools: remove duplicate rows, normalize text, coerce column types, fill or drop missing values, and split or merge columns.

prompts.name: dedupe-and-tidy-orders
prompts.title: Dedupe and tidy an orders sheet
prompts.text: Clean the "Orders" sheet: first remove duplicate rows with clean_dedupe_rows, then trim and title-case the text columns with clean_normalize_text, and report how many duplicates were removed and how many cells changed.

prompts.name: make-columns-numeric
prompts.title: Make pasted columns numeric
prompts.text: The "Import" sheet was pasted from a web page, so amounts like $1,234.56 are stored as text. Use clean_coerce_types to convert the amount and quantity columns to numbers, fill any missing amounts with the column median via clean_fill_missing, then verify the total with a SUM formula.
